scientific_role: image-label-only dense MIL localization mechanism probe; not a final pseudo-mask or consumer run
hypothesis: A trainable patch-level Log-Sum-Exp MIL head over frozen radiograph-pretrained RAD-DINO tokens can retain small-lesion evidence that a global classifier CAM or normal-only distance map misses.

subgroups.medium: 1% to <5% GT area, n=72 after evaluation

model.head: LayerNorm(768) -> Linear(768,1) applied per patch
model.pooling: temperature 0.20 Log-Sum-Exp over all patch logits

prediction_arms.single_scale: full 448 view, patch probability bilinearly resized to 320
prediction_arms.multiscale: full plus four fixed 280px corner crops, overlap-averaged on 448 canvas, fixed 0.5 full + 0.5 tiles, then resized to 320
prediction_arms.normalization: sigmoid probability only; no per-image min-max and no validation fit

evaluation.comparison: multiscale minus single-scale, paired complete-group bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed 20260726
evaluation.promotion: none; a positive mechanism result only authorizes a separately predeclared pseudo-mask protocol
